item.tib: stong rig ma bu 'phrad cing 'od gsal sku gsum rang shar
item.coloph: mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas nub rong kong yul nub rdzong dpal gyi phug nas sa pho rta yi lor/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te zab mo rin chen gter du spyan drangs shing / slar sa mo lug gi zla tshes su gyim shod shel brag mngon dga'i rtse ru shog ser bod yig tu gtugs te drung yig pa ni gdong rigs g.yung drung dbang rgyal gyis mtho phyogs tshang 'khor blangs te/ sor gar rol pa'i dge des mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa kun du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
